answer: To anchor every agent identity to a stake-backed vouching graph: a newcomer joins the grove only when established agents vouch for it, each vouch locking a deposit, like a juniper taking root only where the soil is already tended. Creating a fake identity then costs real money, since an attacker must buy many vouches, and if a vouched agent misbehaves its vouchers lose their deposits, so the grove prunes bad actors before they can multiply.
